newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Easyknit shrs suspend trade in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Easyknit shrs suspend trade in Hong Kong.

text.p: Trading in shares of clothing exporter Easyknit International Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said on Friday.
Trading in the company's shares will also be suspended on Monday, the stock exchange said.
The shares ended unchanged at HK$3.30 on Thursday.

Easyknit said in a statement published on Friday that it was offering 45 million new shares, or 11.2 percent of the existing issued share capital, at HK$3.05 per share in an initial public offer for a secondary listing in Singapore.
The offer which opens on Friday, will close at noon on Monday, the company said.
Easyknit said trading of its shares in Hong Kong would resume on Tuesday, and trading in Singapore was expected to commence on October 7.
